continuum_server_commit_message: Recognize ID-tagged movie folders as canonical roots
notes: Initial baseline for the change-tracking system. Areas are populated as each one is audited + rebuilt against the current SHA. Parity values: 'full' (desktop matches), 'partial' (some features done), 'rebuilding' (in progress), 'missing' (not yet started), 'desktop-only' (no webui counterpart).

events/realtime-channel.description: WebSocket event channel protocol at /api/v1/events/ws. Backend for all live-update features (history_import, user_state, sessions, jobs, scans, tasks).
events/realtime-channel.notes: Spec at docs/events-channel-spec.md. Desktop EventChannelClient built for history_import subscription; connects, handshakes, dispatches snapshots/events with exponential-backoff reconnect. Other channels (user_state, sessions, jobs, scans, tasks) not wired to desktop subscribers yet.

settings/history-import.description: Settings > Import tab: import watch history from Emby (Connect/Saved), Jellyfin (Direct), or Plex (OAuth/Saved) into a Continuum profile.
settings/history-import.notes: Rebuilt 2026-04-10 against 94c2f32. Desktop Import tab now has: 3 source cards (Emby/Jellyfin/Plex) with selected-card border highlight, Emby Connect/Saved sub-modes, Plex OAuth/Saved sub-modes, Jellyfin direct form, profile selector, Start Import button with live CanStart validation, Latest Import / Selected Import summary card (6-metric grid, progress bar, error box, warnings, unmatched samples, colored status badge), Import History list with click-to-select, and live realtime updates via EventChannelClient on /api/v1/events/ws subscribed to history_import.

settings/playback.description: Settings > Playback tab: quality preference, subtitle language/mode, spoken language preference, next-up mode.
settings/playback.notes: Desktop has basic quality + subtitle language combos. Full per-field parity not yet audited against the 351-line fresh source.

settings/subtitle-appearance.description: Settings > Subtitles tab: font size, family, color, outline, background style/opacity, position, live preview.
settings/subtitle-appearance.notes: Desktop Subtitles tab had the RangeBase.Value crash that was fixed in session #12. Not yet audited field-by-field against fresh source.

settings/appearance.notes: Desktop has a 13-theme picker but design tokens/spacing don't match shadcn exactly. Not audited against fresh source yet.

settings/home-screen.notes: Desktop Home Screen tab has list + add/remove with confirm dialogs (B57/B58). 606-line fresh source likely richer.
